output.summary: A large palm native to the Lesser Antilles, Colombia, Venezuela, and Trinidad and Tobago, it has a pale trunk topped by a green crownshaft. Its angled leaflets give the fronds a bottlebrush appearance, and its ripe fruit is purplish-black. The terminal bud is edible, while immature flower clusters have historically been pickled as a vegetable and young-flower sap fermented into alcohol.
